items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: she was a wonderful lady and a good musician, and she made me get involved in everything in junior high school... she had quite an influence on me

ctx.x: Okay. Did they have a music program there?

Oh, yeah. Certainly they did. Everything I did -- and I think that musically, in junior high school it was better for me for music than high school, actually, because that's where I learned to conduct, really, in junior high school.

Because I had a teacher, her name was Ms. Goodrich, and she was a wonderful lady and a good musician, and she made me get involved in everything in junior high school, you know, musically? That was when I was in the glee club and I was in the dramatic class; I played Penrod and Penrod and Sam, and she was quite -- she had quite an influence on me, because she went to Jefferson High School. She transferred and went to Jefferson High School, and when I finished Lafayette, I went to Jefferson High School at first,…
